column4: S4.11: the throw path of the vector iterators is not judged. When the constructor / destructor stub RAISES, sound.dll's ehVectorConstructorIterator (rva 0x42902) unwinds through its SEH frame (scope table 0x1005ed28, finally funclet ehVectorCtor_finally 0x1004296c, which calls __ArrayUnwind 0x1004288e) and the exception goes on through KERNEL32!RaiseException; the fixture VM dispatches no SEH and the port has no frame model, so the port runs the normal path only. Four registry keys of the C3 batches c3fo / c3fz make a stub raise (ehVectorConstructorIterator_snd_t0, ehVectorConstructorIterator_snd_t3, sound___ArrayUnwind_t0, sound___ArrayUnwind_t2) and end at `unmodelled import KERNEL32.dll!RaiseException`: they are EXCLUDED in port/test/sound_keys_crt.py with this id. __ArrayUnwind's own keys (sound___ArrayUnwind 15 vectors, __ArrayUnwind@ 4) and the iterator's six custom vectors judge the non-raising paths. A SEH dispatcher in the fixture VM (the scope-table walk, RaiseException, the finally call) would judge them. No S4 key makes a stub raise, so the census is unaffected.

S4.11: heap types 2 and 3 (the small-block heaps). g_heapType (rva 0xb5d20) has three writers (scan of the mapped image for its address): _heap_init stores crtHeapSelect's result (`mov [0x100b5d20], eax` 0x10045d38 after `call 0x10045bc8`), and setSbhThreshold (rva 0x45e34) stores 3 (0x10045eaa) and 2 (0x10045ed3). crtHeapSelect returns 1 before it looks at the environment or the exe's linker version when GetVersionEx reports dwPlatformId 2 and dwMajorVersion >= 5 (`cmp [ebp-0x88], 2` 0x10045bf1, `cmp [ebp-0x94], 5` 0x10045bfa, `push 1; pop eax` 0x10045c03), and setSbhThreshold has no call and no stored pointer (scan for E8 rel32 and for its dword), so every run on Windows 2000 or later is on the system heap (type 1), as round 23 measured. heap_alloc (0x42b0b) and free (0x42c07) carry the type 3 / 2 arms and are judged on them with recording stand-ins for the helpers they call (keys heap_alloc@sbh3 / @sbh2, free@sbh3 / @sbh2, every jcc of both functions has both sides in the emulated original); msize (0x45581) and crtRealloc (0x45252) throw MissingResource for type 2 / 3 instead (their arms call the small-block internals 0x45f2f, 0x45f5a, 0x470ac, 0x4a460 ... that no step ports); their coverage table (11_coverage.tsv) shows those arms as never executed. Dead code in this build, not a fallback of any key.

S4.11: _sprintf (rva 0x42577) implements the conversions its three callers can produce: d i u o x X c s % with the flags - + space # 0, a width, a precision and the h / l modifiers (35 vectors over 35 formats, the original's __output run on the same formats). The callers: SoundTimer::onTick (rva 0x8f72, format at rva 0x63d98 `timer Late!!! by %d ms`) and the two iostream-style number formatters at rva 0x416d9 / 0x4177d, which build a format of `%`, optional `+` (0x100416ca) or `0`/flags (0x100416b9), an `o` (0x100416ab) or `x` / `X` (0x100416a1) conversion character in a local at [ebp-8]. e f g p n and the `*` width are not implemented (MissingResource); no caller builds them. The `count < 0` arm after __output (rva 0x425ad, __flsbuf) needs more than 0x7fffffff output characters and is not reachable.

S4.11: __lock's allocation-failure arm (rva 0x47735, `__amsg_exit(0x11)`) ends the process, so no key reaches it; the port calls the same function through the dispatcher. The second-thread arm (the slot is filled while this thread waits for lock 0x11, rva 0x4774b) is judged with an EnterCriticalSection stand-in that fills the slot (key __lock@race).

S4.11: S4.10's pending callees (return0_479820, NodeList / NodeListB / NodeListC::dtor) are golf_clean.exe functions (re/names/model_h2.tsv 0x00479820, exe_4.tsv 0x00487390 / 0x00487a60 / 0x00487b80), not sound.dll's: they are the engine-glue module's and stay with S4.10 / S1-S3 integration. This step closes the sound.dll side only.
